title: Harsewinkel - Google Arts & Culture
content: # Harsewinkel. Harsewinkel is a town in Gütersloh District in the state of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It lies on the river Ems, some 15 km north-west of Gütersloh. It is the home and domicile of Europe's leading combine harvester manufacturer CLAAS, which is a major employer in the town. ### Discover this place. ### 59 items.
